title: Research Projects in Data-Centric AI
summary: A collection of Jupyter notebooks exploring data-centric AI research topics such as near-duplicate detection, PU learning, and data synthesis. Its dataSynthesis.ipynb notebook imports sdv's SingleTableMetadata and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and also uses the standalone ctgan package, to generate synthetic minority-class samples for class balancing.
